en.headline: Bus driver arrested after motorcyclist critically injured in Tung Chung crash
en.dek: A 58-year-old motorcyclist was trapped under a bus and left unconscious after a collision at Tung Chung East Interchange on Thursday evening; the 60-year-old bus driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm.
body: A motorcyclist was critically injured and a bus driver arrested after a collision at Tung Chung East Interchange on Thursday evening.

Police said they received a report at about 6.06pm that a Long Win Bus on route E42 had collided with a motorcycle at the interchange. The motorcyclist, a 58-year-old man surnamed Li, was trapped under the bus and dragged a short distance before firefighters freed him. He was unconscious and taken to North Lantau Hospital for emergency treatment.

The 60-year-old bus driver, surnamed Wong, passed an alcohol test but was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. He was detained for further inquiries. Police said the case remained under investigation and partial lane closures caused traffic disruption until about 7pm.

zh.headline: 東涌巴士電單車相撞 鐵騎士重傷昏迷 車長被捕
zh.dek: 周四傍晚東涌東交匯處一輛龍運巴士與電單車相撞，58歲鐵騎士被捲入車底拖行後昏迷送院，60歲巴士車長涉危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。
body: 東涌東交匯處周四傍晚發生嚴重車禍，一名電單車司機重傷昏迷，巴士車長被捕。
警方晚上約6時06分接報，一輛E42線龍運巴士與一輛電單車在交匯處相撞，58歲姓李鐵騎士被捲入巴士車底並被拖行一段距離。消防救出傷者時他已陷入昏迷，隨即由救護車送往北大嶼山醫院搶救。
60歲姓黃巴士車長通過酒精測試，但涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被拘捕扣查。警方表示案件仍在調查，事故期間部分行車線受阻，至晚上約7時解封。
